Heavy rain from the coastal storm may lead to flooding, especially in low-lying and poor-drainage areas. Coastal communities may also experience coastal flooding and rising water levels.

If you encounter flooding:
• Avoid flooded roads and areas where water is covering the roadway.
• Turn Around, Don’t Drown. Never drive or walk through floodwater.
• Just a few inches of moving water can be dangerous and may hide hazards beneath the surface.
• If you are in an area experiencing flooding, move to higher ground when it is safe to do so.

Also, be sure to clear leaves and debris from drains and storm drains, as strong winds can cause them to become clogged and prevent water from draining properly.

Stay informed by monitoring local forecasts and emergency alerts and never ignore evacuation or emergency instructions from local officials.
